$comment: Security headers for the deployed static app. Applies when web/ is the Vercel project root. The CSP mirrors the meta tag injected at build time, plus frame-ancestors (which a meta tag cannot set). connect-src 'self' is the exfiltration lock: the browser blocks any network request off this origin.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
